title: Tonemap sRGB-conversion flag set on bit 7 while the shader tests bit 6
expected_finding: the host requests linear->sRGB conversion with TONEMAP_FLAG_CONVERT_TO_SRGB = (1 << 7), but fsMain tests FLAG_CONVERT_TO_SRGB = (1 << 6): the conversion never runs and linear tonemapped colour is written to the B8G8R8A8_UNORM viewport target, which is displayed as sRGB
